metadata.description: Circuit simulation (LTspice/ngspice) with structured results incl. per-device operating points (gm/gds/vth) by name, plus LTspice .asc schematic editing, for Claude Code.

plugins.name: ltspice-mcp
plugins.description: LTspice/ngspice circuit simulation (structured results incl. per-device operating points gm/gds/vth by name, no rawfile parsing) and .asc schematic editing as MCP tools. Requires uv and a simulator (LTspice or ngspice) on the host; the server is fetched from PyPI via uvx on first use.
